evidenceBoundary: Definitions apply to the repository's synthetic CRM, ERP, and Inventory fixtures and are not approved enterprise targets.
currency: unspecified for Sales; Inventory source contract is EUR

kpis.businessQuestion: What normalized sales value is published in the selected scope?
kpis.definition: Sum of curated sales_amount. Silver recalculates each accepted amount as positive quantity multiplied by normalized positive price; this is not the raw source-recorded amount.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Respects report filters and country RLS; invalid source rows are quarantined before Gold publication.
kpis.limitations: Sales currency is unspecified; synthetic reference results only.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many accepted sales lines are published?
kpis.definition: Count of curated Gold sales rows loaded into the semantic model.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Counts only accepted published rows and respects report filters and RLS.
kpis.limitations: Not a source row count and excludes quarantined source rows.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many orders are represented?
kpis.definition: Count of nonblank distinct order numbers.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Excludes blank order numbers.
kpis.limitations: Order number is not a sales-line key.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many accepted units were sold?
kpis.definition: Sum of positive curated line quantities.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Invalid or nonpositive source quantities are quarantined before publication.
kpis.limitations: Synthetic reference data.

kpis.businessQuestion: What is normalized sales value per sold unit?
kpis.definition: Total Sales divided by Total Quantity.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Returns blank when quantity is zero or blank.
kpis.limitations: Weighted unit value, not an unweighted average of line prices.

kpis.businessQuestion: What is average curated sales value per represented order?
kpis.definition: Total Sales divided by Distinct Orders.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Returns blank when no orders are present.
kpis.limitations: Not customer lifetime or invoice value.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many distinct purchasing customers are represented?
kpis.definition: Count of nonblank distinct customer IDs in Sales.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Excludes blank customer IDs and respects country RLS.
kpis.limitations: Does not mean all registered customers.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many distinct product numbers occur in Sales?
kpis.definition: Distinct count of descriptive product numbers on accepted sales lines.
kpis.grain: Product number within selected sales scope
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Respects report filters and RLS.
kpis.limitations: Counts business numbers, not effective-dated Product versions.

kpis.businessQuestion: What effective-dated master-cost estimate is associated with sold units?
kpis.definition: Quantity multiplied by the Product master cost version resolved for each sales line.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Uses the persisted Gold Product surrogate key resolved against the order-date validity interval.
kpis.limitations: Estimate only; not an accounting posting and excludes freight, tax, returns, discounts, and allocations.

kpis.businessQuestion: What curated sales value remains after estimated Product master cost?
kpis.definition: Total Sales minus Estimated COGS.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Inherits component filters.
kpis.limitations: Not accounting gross profit; always label Estimated.

kpis.businessQuestion: What share of curated sales remains after estimated Product master cost?
kpis.definition: Estimated Gross Profit divided by Total Sales.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Returns blank when sales is zero or blank.
kpis.limitations: Not accounting margin; missing Product costs require separate DQ review.

kpis.businessQuestion: What was curated sales in the equivalent prior-year context?
kpis.definition: Total Sales shifted one year through the explicit Date table.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Requires a valid contiguous Date selection.
kpis.limitations: Returns blank where no comparable prior period exists.

kpis.businessQuestion: What is the absolute sales change from the equivalent prior-year period?
kpis.definition: Total Sales minus Sales Previous Year.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Inherits the current and prior-year contexts.
kpis.limitations: No seasonal adjustment or target comparison.

kpis.businessQuestion: How did sales change against the equivalent prior-year period?
kpis.definition: Absolute year-over-year change divided by Sales Previous Year.
kpis.formula: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Sales Previous Year]) && [Sales Previous Year] <> 0, DIVIDE([Total Sales] - [Sales Previous Year], [Sales Previous Year]))
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Returns blank when the prior baseline is missing or zero.
kpis.limitations: No seasonal adjustment or target comparison.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many eligible orders shipped after their due date?
kpis.definition: Count of orders whose latest ship date is after their earliest due date.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Excludes orders without ship or due date.
kpis.limitations: Not proof of late delivery to the customer.

kpis.businessQuestion: What share of eligible orders shipped by their due date?
kpis.definition: Eligible orders with latest ship date on or before earliest due date divided by eligible orders.
kpis.formula: Order-grain eligible and on-time FILTER over VALUES(Sales[order_number])
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Excludes orders without ship or due date.
kpis.limitations: Shipment metric, not delivery confirmation.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many days elapse from order to shipment on average?
kpis.definition: Average nonnegative day difference between earliest order date and latest ship date at order grain.
kpis.formula: AVERAGEX(eligible orders, DATEDIFF(order date, ship date, DAY))
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Requires both dates and excludes negative durations.
kpis.limitations: Calendar days; not working days and not delivery duration.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many accepted inventory snapshot rows are visible in the selected scope?
kpis.definition: Count of curated Inventory Snapshot rows after report filters and country RLS.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Counts accepted published rows and respects warehouse/date filters and country RLS.
kpis.limitations: Counts rows across selected snapshot dates; not a point-in-time quantity.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many units are available in the selected inventory snapshot scope?
kpis.definition: Sum of on-hand quantity less reserved quantity at snapshot-line grain.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Must use an intentional snapshot date; summing snapshots is not an ending balance.
kpis.limitations: Semi-additive over time and based on synthetic snapshots.

kpis.businessQuestion: What source-snapshot unit-cost value is associated with on-hand inventory?
kpis.definition: Sum of persisted inventory_value, calculated in Silver as on_hand_qty multiplied by source snapshot unit_cost.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Must use an intentional snapshot date; uses Inventory snapshot cost, not Product master cost.
kpis.limitations: EUR by source contract, not an accounting valuation, and semi-additive over time.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many snapshot lines are at or below their reorder point?
kpis.definition: Count of snapshot lines whose available quantity is less than or equal to the recorded reorder point.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Counts lines, not distinct Products; respects Product, warehouse, and snapshot filters.
kpis.limitations: A Product repeated across warehouses or dates can contribute multiple lines.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many published Gold sales rows have a blank order date?
kpis.definition: Count of rows in the curated Sales model whose published order_date is blank.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: This measure does not count source rejects: malformed source dates are quarantined as INVALID_ORDER_DATE before Gold. Use control.load_reject for source-level failures.
kpis.limitations: Normally zero in the curated model and cannot expose the original rejected value.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many published sales lines violate the curated amount equation?
kpis.definition: Count of Sales rows where sales_amount differs from quantity multiplied by price.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Operates on normalized accepted Gold values.
kpis.limitations: Does not count quarantined source rows or preserve raw source discrepancies.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many curated Customers have no normalized country code?
kpis.definition: Count of Customers rows with blank country_code.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Subject to report filters; the DQ check table provides a separately materialized global check.
kpis.limitations: The semantic country_code recognizes only the explicitly mapped reference values.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many curated Customers are flagged as future-dated?
kpis.definition: Count of Customers rows whose persisted future-date flag is true.
kpis.dateContext: Customer creation date versus pipeline time
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Subject to report filters.
kpis.limitations: Flag was derived at load time; it is not recalculated by Power BI.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many imported Product versions have missing or nonpositive cost?
kpis.definition: Count of Product rows with blank or nonpositive product_cost.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Subject to Product filters; includes imported history, while the materialized global check is scoped to current Product rows.
kpis.limitations: Scope differs from the current-row-only materialized DQ check.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many failed-row occurrences are reported by materialized DQ checks?
kpis.definition: Sum of FailedRows across the imported DQ check table.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Includes evaluated checks in the current filter context; counts may overlap across checks.
kpis.limitations: Not a distinct bad-row count and not a production quality score.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many evaluated checks have failed?
kpis.definition: Count of evaluated materialized checks whose Status is Failed.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Excludes explicitly unevaluated checks.
kpis.limitations: Combines Error and Warning severities; use severity-specific measures for release interpretation.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many evaluated Error-severity checks have failed?
kpis.definition: Count of evaluated Error checks with one or more failed rows.
kpis.formula: COUNTROWS(FILTER('Data Quality Checks', IsEvaluated && Severity = "Error" && FailedRows > 0))
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Excludes warnings and unevaluated checks.
kpis.limitations: Severity values are repository reference classifications, not enterprise policy approvals.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many evaluated Warning-severity checks have failed?
kpis.definition: Count of evaluated Warning checks with one or more failed rows.
kpis.formula: COUNTROWS(FILTER('Data Quality Checks', IsEvaluated && Severity = "Warning" && FailedRows > 0))
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Excludes errors and unevaluated checks.
kpis.limitations: Severity values are repository reference classifications, not enterprise policy approvals.

kpis.businessQuestion: What share of evaluated checks has zero failed rows?
kpis.definition: Average binary pass rate across evaluated materialized checks.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Check-weighted; unevaluated checks are excluded.
kpis.limitations: A zero evaluated count returns blank; different checks may cover different row populations.

kpis.businessQuestion: How many materialized checks were not evaluated?
kpis.definition: Count of DQ check rows whose IsEvaluated flag is false.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Respects filters on the check table.
kpis.limitations: Does not explain why evaluation was unavailable.

kpis.businessQuestion: What is the current release-oriented DQ status?
kpis.definition: Failed when any evaluated Error check fails; otherwise Not run when no checks were evaluated or any check is unevaluated; otherwise Passed with warnings when any Warning check fails; otherwise Passed.
kpis.formula: SWITCH over Error failures, evaluated count, not-evaluated count, and Warning failures
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Status follows the current check-table filter context and severity precedence.
kpis.limitations: Reference release signal only; it does not replace accountable approval.

kpis.businessQuestion: When did the imported dataset refresh evaluation occur?
kpis.definition: Maximum refresh timestamp from the generated Refresh Metadata row.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Refresh Metadata is hidden and generated at import evaluation.
kpis.limitations: Not the source extraction time and not evidence of a successful Power BI Service schedule.

kpis.businessQuestion: What is the latest published sales order date in scope?
kpis.definition: Maximum curated Sales order_date.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Respects current Sales filters and RLS.
kpis.limitations: Not a source delivery watermark and excludes Inventory snapshot freshness.

kpis.businessQuestion: How is the dataset evidence boundary labelled?
kpis.definition: Static text identifying the content as synthetic reference data.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: No filter dependence.
kpis.limitations: A label, not a quality or freshness assertion.

kpis.businessQuestion: Which Customer country codes are visible in the current access context?
kpis.definition: Concatenated visible nonblank Customer country codes, or No entitled rows.
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: The label reflects the Customer/Sales RLS path only. Inventory is independently protected through Inventory Locations; global DQ and Refresh tables remain unfiltered.
kpis.limitations: Not a security proof and not an Inventory entitlement label.

kpis.businessQuestion: What sales-through and dataset-refresh context should be displayed?
kpis.definition: Text combining Data Through Date and Last Dataset Refresh UTC.
kpis.formula: Formatted [Data Through Date] plus [Last Dataset Refresh UTC]
kpis.dateContext: Order date and UTC refresh time
kpis.filtersAndExclusions: Data-through date follows Sales filters; refresh timestamp is global metadata.
kpis.limitations: Does not report Inventory source freshness or pipeline watermark.
